messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Meloxicam can increase your risk of a fatal heart attack or stroke.
This risk is especially high if you use Meloxicam long term.
The risk is also higher if you take high doses.
The risk is further increased if you have heart disease.
Even people without heart disease or risk factors could have a stroke or heart attack while taking Meloxicam.
Do not use Meloxicam just before or after heart bypass surgery (coronary artery bypass graft, or CABG).
Avoid taking meloxicam after a recent heart attack, unless your doctor tells you to.
You may have an increased risk of another heart attack if you take Meloxicam after a recent heart attack.
Get emergency medical help if you have chest pain, weakness, shortness of breath, slurred speech, or problems with vision or balance.
Meloxicam may also cause stomach or intestinal bleeding.
This bleeding can be fatal.
These conditions can occur without warning while you are using Meloxicam, especially in older adults.
Call your doctor at once if you have symptoms of stomach bleeding.
Such symptoms include black, bloody, or tarry stools.
Triplet: ["Meloxicam", "has symptom to report", "black, bloody, or tarry stools"]

The relation 'has symptom to report' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause the specific symptom or sign specified by the object entity, which should be promptly reported to a healthcare provider.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
C. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has reporting instruction': The subject drug requires the reporting action specified by the object entity to be followed by the patient.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
